description: This file defines the TransactionService class, providing CRUD operations for transaction data via an API client.

classes.name: TransactionService
classes.description: A service class providing CRUD methods for transactions, interacting with an API endpoint.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Fetches a list of transactions, optionally filtered by month.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates a new transaction entry via API.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates an existing transaction identified by ID.

methods.name: remove
methods.description: Deletes a transaction identified by ID.
